header.contentDescription: A 3D model of a DNA double helix, twenty base pairs, turning slowly: two backbones of beads and base-pair rungs coloured by base, adenine with thymine and guanine with cytosine. Strand one reads ATGCGTACCGATTAGCCTAG. Drag to turn it; the Unzip button separates the strands from the top down

text.value: B-DNA · 10 base pairs a turn · 3.4 nm a turn
A pairs with T, G with C
